name: Small overruns, settled from a pool
title: Small overruns, settled from a pool
story: A card has a budget of 5.00 euro with 4.60 spent. A session on the big model needs 0.60, so the card stops and asks: Fund one more session? At manual and assisted the ask goes to the person in Needs you. At autonomous and full auto the project agent wakes first. It may fund from the monthly pool (10 euro a month) inside three limits set in the project's file: a raise limit of 1.00, a card cap of 15, and a pool that is never overspent. 0.60 fits, so the agent funds one more session and the raise counts against the pool. A raise of 4.00 is beyond a limit: it is refused and the ask reaches the person with the agent's analysis.
